# Recreation Prompt

Create a self-contained mobile-first browser game titled `Sprigfox Field League`: a bright creature-collector RPG battle route where a rookie trainer bonds with a starter monster and clears three rival elemental trials. Preserve the exact mechanics of the source turn battler: menu setup, story cards, combat HUD, four menu moves, HP bars, timed AI opponent, damage and meter rules, victory/failure result overlay, chapter advancement, rematch, and full-clear HP growth.

Reinterpret the four actions as Tackle, Element Burst, Cheer, and Evolve Burst. Keep Tackle at 10-15 damage, Element Burst at 15-25 damage, Cheer at +30 bond, Evolve Burst locked until 100 bond and dealing 50. Damaging moves add +10 bond. The AI should act every 2-3 seconds and choose 60% Tackle, 30% Element Burst, 10% Cheer.

Build the scene with procedural canvas art: animated route, sun/clouds, tall grass, collectible codex cards, and rounded elemental companion creatures. UI should be portrait-first with large bottom buttons, top HP panels, clear readable labels, and friendly coming-of-age adventure copy. Use catalog-approved fonts/audio only when media is used, and keep failures non-blocking.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
The preserved source is a single-file browser canvas/DOM turn battler named `Arena Legends`. The player enters a name/color, starts a run, reads a chapter card, enters combat, chooses from four move buttons, watches a timed AI opponent answer, and reaches a result overlay when either HP pool reaches zero.

## Protected Mechanics
- State flow: menu -> story -> combat -> result -> next chapter/rematch.
- Inputs: text/color entry, start button, fight button, four move buttons, continue/rematch button.
- Combat rules: Strike/Tackle deals 10-15; Grapple/Element Burst deals 15-25; Taunt/Cheer adds 30 meter; Finisher/Evolve Burst requires 100 meter, spends it, and deals 50.
- Meter rule: every damaging move adds 10 meter to the attacker.
- AI rule: opponent acts on a 2000-3000 ms timer and selects random move with 60% strike, 30% grapple, 10% taunt.
- Chapter progression: three opponents with HP 80, 120, and 200; victory advances chapter, loss rematches, full clear resets chapter and adds 20 player max HP.

## Safe Transformation Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title, chapter copy, color roles, background, canvas character drawing, particles, floating text, fonts, audio labels, menu layout polish, feedback chips, and world semantics are all presentation-facing and safe to transform.

## Rebuilt Game Identity
`Sprigfox Field League` reinterprets the same loop as a mobile-first creature-collector field route. The player is a rookie trainer guiding a starter monster through three rival elemental trials, collecting journal entries and building an evolution bond meter.

## Mobile Direction
Portrait is primary. All CTAs and move buttons are large, bottom-aligned, and reachable; health/status panels stay compact at the top; overlays use readable cards without blocking restart/continue paths.
